headline: East African Portland Cement Annual Profit Drops 68.6% to Sh1.58 Billion
summary: East African Portland Cement Company reported a 68.6 percent drop in profit after tax to Sh1.58 billion for the financial year ended June 2026, down from Sh5.02 billion previously.
why: East African Portland Cement Company is a major cement manufacturer in Kenya, serving the regional construction and real estate sectors.

impacts.name: East African Portland Cement Company
impacts.why: Lower net profit reflects weaker financial performance for the reporting period.
